apps.name: Assist

apps.name: Datum
apps.description: Linked spreadsheets, slides, docs and dashboards

apps.name: RO3
apps.description: Photo editing, video editing and file conversion

apps.name: Relay
apps.description: Inboxes, calendars, chats, browser and AI in one place

apps.name: Fresh Desk
apps.description: A fast file explorer with tabs, preview, Terminal and Tidy

apps.name: Utility Hub
apps.description: Install, update and remove the Utility Suite apps

apps.name: Onward
apps.description: Job hunting with your AI plugged in

apps.name: Slate
apps.description: Accounts, retirement, credit cards, credit score and a monthly savings plan in one place.

apps.name: Sideby
apps.description: Watch anything together with friends, in sync

apps.name: Kiln
apps.description: Install, run and create with Stable Diffusion apps — models, profiles, prompts and a built-in browser.

apps.name: Crate
apps.description: Download music as MP3s, then tag, edit and organize it into albums for your phone.

apps.name: Lumen
apps.description: Ads and analytics in one calm place: Meta first, with Google, YouTube and Salesforce next, plus an AI you can ask.

apps.name: Trace
apps.description: Map paths, decisions, org charts and folder plans, trace them with a smooth zoom, keep notes, and turn screenshots into guides.

apps.name: Docket
apps.description: Takes notes in your Zoom, Teams and Meet calls: transcribes on your computer, summarizes, and keeps one to-do list from every meeting.

apps.name: Glean
apps.description: Collect every photo and video from Instagram, Facebook, Patreon or any page you can see, at full size and grouped by post with captions, then keep each account up to date.

apps.name: Vitals
apps.description: A better task manager and system dashboard: live CPU, memory, GPU and temperatures, every app and what it uses, uninstalling, startup items, privacy permissions, time and focus tracking, and a one-click checkup.

apps.name: Touchline
apps.description: Football scores, tables, match stats, squads and player histories for every league and every season.

apps.name: Scene
apps.description: Save and switch whole setups in one click: the apps, where every window sits on which display, the sites and files that open with them, volume, appearance and wallpaper, for work, gaming, match day or anything else.

apps.name: Droid
apps.description: Virtual Android phones and tablets: build Pixel, Galaxy, island-style or tablet devices with your choice of Android version, screen, memory, cores, storage, network and location, run several at once, drag in apps and files, and get apps from F-Droid, Google Play or APK sites.

apps.name: Decomp
apps.description: Take any app apart: decompiles Windows, Mac, Linux, Android, iOS, Java, .NET, Python, Electron and WebAssembly apps, and opens installers, disc images (ISO, UDF, DMG, VHD, CSO, Xbox, GameCube), game packs and firmware, using every core on the computer.

apps.name: Cadence
apps.description: Automations on your schedule: pull reports from sites with a signed-in browser, file them in folders named for the week, compare with last week and build PowerPoint slides and PDF reports, with Claude and Codex plugged in to build and run them.

apps.name: Beam
apps.description: AirDrop for Macs, PCs and phones: send files, folders, text and links straight to nearby devices, encrypted end to end and as fast as the network allows.

apps.name: Waypoint
apps.description: Travel planning and booking: flight and hotel search with booking, trips with interactive day timelines, bookings, documents, budgets and research, all offline, handed to your phone or another computer in seconds.

apps.name: Facet
apps.description: Make 3D models from a prompt or a picture, generated on this computer with its own GPU: sketch ideas from a prompt, turn photos into meshes, view, and export GLB, OBJ, STL and PLY. No accounts, no tokens, no uploads.

apps.name: Atoll
apps.description: A Dynamic Island for your desktop: timers and focus sessions, music controls, one live football match from Touchline, a shelf for files and recent copies, weather and a system glance, tucked into the notch on a MacBook and floating at the top of the screen everywhere else.

apps.name: RO2
apps.description: Quick, easy designs and photo edits: shapes, icons, text and free photos at any size or aspect ratio, a background remover, magic eraser, magic grab and magic expand that run on this computer, and export to PNG, JPG, WebP, SVG and PDF.

apps.name: Bench
apps.description: A desktop workspace for Claude to test apps: sandbox desks that run apps on this computer with their own data, clean Mac, Linux and Windows desktops in virtual machines, a live view, parallel smoke tests, findings, and a Claude plugin to launch, click, type, read errors and file bugs.

apps.name: Vantage
apps.description: A fast, private browser: up to four pages on one screen, built-in ad blocking and VPN, multi-connection downloads, the password vault with autofill, and your Library.
